hooks.name: Render check on synthesis save
hooks.description: Renders the changed ghost sound at 44100 and 48000 Hz and checks the band, fade, duration and level rules. Findings go to the agent. See .kiro/specs/ghost-sounds/design.md.

hooks.name: Render check after an agent write
hooks.description: The PostToolUse fallback of D20. Runs the same render check after every built-in file write by the agent. See .kiro/specs/ghost-sounds/design.md.
